reviewCriteria: Stroller gate width and continuous step-free route; contact companion, establish platform and reunion point before following.
Moving-in address: contract versus self-abbreviated delivery note; do not guess building name, applicant opens envelope, one applicant and missing-document check.
Two medical appointments: institution and date/time identity, self-entry error, unavailable mornings, clinician approval before rescheduling and separate slips.
Outward application delivery and return envelope: separate tracking requirement, return addressee and cost; check records and conditions before choosing and sealing.
Student account purpose is family living-cost receipt, no salary plan; student ID not presumed sufficient, dorm address verification and account eligibility remain unconfirmed.
Two-bottle drink pricing: eligibility depends on product and flavor, not container shape; buying one unsweetened bottle can take priority over discount quantity.
Rainy park: unsuitable shoes and wet dirt, short paved route remains conditional, verify return parking route and rest-area route against local signs; do not assume map alone proves passability.

Missing bicycle: photograph is one month old at home, basket changed from small white to large black; today’s side-wall row and pillar sign are separate from photo location; 13:00 parking and about14:00 return.
